modules.title: Blood in urine (hematuria) history — structure
points: Hematuria is blood in urine — analogous to melena/hematochezia principle: symptom first, disease later.
Do not label the visit 'bladder cancer' or 'UTI' as the complaint.
Distinguish true hematuria from other causes of red urine when possible.
